title: RELIANCE INDUSTRIES LTD – Valuation Football Field
body: The DCF Base‑case equity value per share of ₹1,107 sits below the current trading price of ₹1,226, suggesting a potential upside of about 12% if the model assumptions hold. Our trailing 3‑year sales CAGR of 14.8% and EBITDA margin range of 19.05–19.69% underpin the growth assumptions. The WACC of 10.73% (cost of equity 12.27%, post‑tax cost of debt 5.63%) and a conservative 5% terminal growth assumption keep the valuation on a steady trajectory. Overall, the market appears to be pricing in the base‑case growth trajectory, with limited upside beyond the bull‑case scenario.
